review_pair_status: current best two successfully scored candidates as of 2026-10-24; not a final private-leaderboard selection

alpha_c1.transform: P4 = alpha_c1 * C1, applied to all four score fields on official rows

provenance.formula: alpha = E[C1*y]/E[C1^2]; E[C1*y] = (MSE(C0)+E[C1^2]-RMSE(C1)^2)/2, using the C0/C1 public --status scores and E[C1^2] over the 9,379 official rows

scope.template_only_policy: P4 uses the unweighted mean of each transformed field over the 9,379 official rows; C0 is zero. Template-only values are processing fills, not target evidence.
